I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/libxml2`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Invalid free and uninitialized-value in XInclude processing: while processing XInclude nodes (xmlXIncludeDoProcess in xinclude.c), libxml2's node-copy/free path (xmlStaticCopyNode/xmlFreeNode/xmlFreeNodeList/xmlFreeDoc in tree.c) attempts to free a pointer that was not returned by malloc (free on an interior address of an allocated block), causing heap corruption and crashes. MSAN also reports a use-of-uninitialized-value in the same XInclude/doc node creation path (xmlDictLookup/xmlNewDocNode), leading to undefined behavior and further memory corruption risk.
